digest.component_or_area: rebar review command and library surface deprecation
propositions: rebar review must be retired as a first-class command and replaced with a loud deprecation shim that forwards to rebar review-plan while preserving read-only semantics by passing --no-sign unconditionally
the shim must reject --graph and positional reviewer_id with exit code 2 and an error message naming review-plan, rather than silently discarding these arguments

rebar.llm.review_ticket library function must be split into public facade (emitting lib deprecation warning) and private _review_ticket_impl (called by MCP tool and internal harnesses to avoid double-signalling)
three deprecation rows (cli, lib, mcp) must be registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY with permanent=False and remove_in=v1.0.0, routing through the standard warn_deprecated() mechanism

the CLI shim must preserve the old verb's read-only contract—no signed attestation—while documenting the behavioural divergence that review-plan fast-fails on non-claimable tickets whereas the old verb would have run the model
OUTPUT_SCHEMAS must repoint review to PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT and wire the orphaned REVIEW_RESULT schema under a synthetic review_ticket key to match the surviving library/MCP surface
